title: Local convergence of Sussmann's infinite product for analytic vector fields
summary: In 1986, Sussmann proposed an expansion of the Chen series as an infinite product of exponentials of Hall basis elements multiplied by coefficients defined through a simple induction. He proved that this product converges locally in time for bilinear control systems associated with matrices or bounded operators. In this note, we prove that Sussmann's product also converges locally in time for control-affine systems driven by analytic vector fields.
